rules.reason: Existing shell controls have compact focus, tooltip, and menu-anchor behavior that must migrate as one keyboard-tested unit.
rules.removalCondition: Replace the remaining direct controls when the shell interaction regression suite covers focus return, mobile navigation, and account-menu anchoring.

rules.reason: Existing administration workflows predate the public Form, Dialog, and Grid contracts and include coupled validation and optimistic-lock behavior.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate each workflow with its desktop, mobile, keyboard, partial-failure, and version-conflict journey; never replace primitives without preserving behavior.

rules.reason: Home composition controls retain legacy compact launch and edit interactions covered by existing product tests.
rules.removalCondition: Remove when Home Studio and launchpad share the design-system action and form contracts with equivalent drag, focus, and empty-state coverage.

rules.reason: Directory and organization-design interactions include graph, effective-date, and scenario controls that require domain-level migration rather than mechanical wrapping.
rules.removalCondition: Remove per journey after population policy, effective dating, graph keyboard operation, conflict preview, and mobile inspector tests pass.

rules.reason: Established Provider workflows retain legacy controls around high-risk approval, support, incident, and tenant lifecycle operations.
rules.removalCondition: Convert when each operation uses shared approval and resource patterns with SoD, stale-version, retry, rollback, and audit journey coverage.

rules.reason: The command search dialog has specialized combobox focus and partial-source behavior pending a public command-palette contract.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after a reusable permission-aware command palette ships with keyboard, source-failure, and route-restoration tests.

rules.reason: Layout-level icon actions coordinate responsive navigation and focus restoration across product shells.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after shell primitives own responsive navigation, focus restoration, and compact-mode behavior across all layouts.

rules.reason: Account forms mix autosave, managed-policy, reauthentication, and session controls that require end-to-end migration.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after autosave state, managed policy, reauthentication boundary, session revocation, and mobile keyboard journeys use public contracts.

rules.reason: Account activation is a security-sensitive standalone flow with existing legacy form controls.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after activation, expiry, invalid token, password policy, and screen-reader journeys pass on the shared auth form contract.

rules.reason: Account security surfaces still mix legacy query-state primitives with reauthentication and privileged-access controls.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate each query boundary to shared loading and error contracts with reauthentication, keyboard, and mobile evidence.

rules.reason: The activity timeline retains product-owned density and typography specifications while the shared timeline presentation contract is established.
rules.removalCondition: Remove after activity events use shared surface, typography, density, and responsive timeline tokens with desktop, mobile, keyboard, and partial-source coverage.

rules.reason: Approval work queues and policy studios retain contextual legacy state indicators around governed commands.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate per workflow after loading, partial-error, stale-version, retry, and approval-command journeys pass.

rules.reason: Calendar views use shape-preserving loading and inline conflict states while time-grid interactions stabilize.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after shared query states preserve time-grid geometry, recurrence, keyboard, mobile, and partial-source behavior.

rules.reason: Publishing and acknowledgement workflows retain contextual state primitives tied to content lifecycle operations.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after draft, publish, acknowledgement, retry, and partial-feed journeys use shared state contracts.

rules.reason: Agent execution, approval gates, and streaming answers require specialized progressive status presentation.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after shared states cover streaming, approval, cancellation, partial tool failure, and reduced-motion journeys.

rules.reason: People operations retain legacy loading and alert patterns across policy-sensitive employee workflows.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate per journey with role, privacy, effective-date, partial-failure, mobile, and keyboard evidence.

rules.reason: Home Studio controls retain compact state feedback around draft preview and device overlays.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after draft, preview, publish-conflict, responsive-device, and keyboard journeys use public contracts.

rules.reason: Mailbox synchronization and draft lifecycle use contextual state indicators that must preserve optimistic continuity.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after sync, draft recovery, undo, partial-folder, offline, keyboard, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Live meeting and artifact processing surfaces require media-specific progressive and degraded states.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after lobby, live media, reconnect, artifact processing, accessibility, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Conversation, attachment, and live meeting states must preserve streaming continuity and compact density.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after send, retry, attachment, presence, partial-history, keyboard, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Notification delivery, policy, and bulk actions retain contextual state primitives around live invalidation.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after live refresh, bulk undo, suppression, policy, partial-source, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Booking and spatial-governance views use geometry-preserving loading and localized command feedback.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after availability, booking conflict, floor plan, governance, keyboard, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Catalog and operations workflows mix legacy query states with long-running service commands.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after catalog, request, retry, partial-failure, command progress, keyboard, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Collaboration spaces retain contextual state primitives around membership and ownership operations.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after directory, membership, ownership recovery, request, partial-failure, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Cross-product work items retain source-specific status while common action contracts evolve.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after source identity, action handoff, retry, permission, keyboard, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Workforce planning and export workflows retain legacy state presentation around governed datasets.
rules.removalCondition: Migrate after planning, export, privacy, partial-data, effective-date, and mobile journeys pass.

rules.reason: Route error and suspense boundaries retain minimal primitives before the product design system is available.
rules.removalCondition: Remove when boot-safe shared route loading and error contracts cover chunk failure, retry, focus, and localization.

rules.reason: A small set of established workspace pages still use direct controls for page-specific command surfaces.
rules.removalCondition: Remove when the owning page is next changed and its representative desktop, mobile, keyboard, empty, and error journeys are migrated together.
